mapper.select: SELECT o.object_code AS objectCode, o.object_name AS objectName, o.icon AS objectIcon, o.config_key AS configKey, a.id AS applicationId, a.application_name AS applicationName, a.icon AS applicationIcon, COALESCE(ao.sort_order, o.sort_order) AS sortOrder FROM ai_business_binding b INNER JOIN ai_business_object o ON o.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND o.object_code = b.target_code AND o.status = 1 AND o.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_business_application_object ao ON ao.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND ao.object_id = o.id AND ao.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_business_application a ON a.tenant_id = ao.tenant_id AND a.id = ao.application_id AND a.status = 1 AND a.del_flag = 0 WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.target_type = 'OBJECT' AND b.binding_type = 'FLOW' AND b.status = 1 AND o.config_key IS NOT NULL AND o.config_key != '' AND (ao.id IS NULL OR a.id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY o.id, o.object_code, o.object_name, o.icon, o.config_key, o.sort_order, a.id, a.application_name, a.icon, ao.sort_order ORDER BY a.id IS NULL, a.id, sortOrder, o.object_name
